featured_reviews.name: jaypratap yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing and unsafe experience at the 9D Cinema operated by Zen Enterprises in Maxus Mall, Bhayandar.

The staff here are extremely immature and completely incapable of handling even basic situations. They lack proper training and professionalism, which makes the whole experience frustrating and uncomfortable for visitors.

What is even more concerning is the poor hygiene. The area and equipment do not appear to be cleaned properly, which raises serious health concerns, especially when children are using the facility.

Safety standards also seem to be completely ignored. There was no proper supervision or safety guidance provided for children, which is absolutely unacceptable for an attraction like this. When kids are involved, safety should be the top priority, but clearly that is not the case here.

Overall, this place is poorly managed and not worth the money. I would strongly advise parents and families to think twice before letting their children use this attraction.

featured_reviews.name: Noel Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: Maxus Fun World is a place to play arcade games with your friends, it's located inside Maxus Mall in Bhayandar West. There are many games inside like bowling, pool, dashing cars, kids play area, and more arcade games. The place is cool but it needs to be maintained better, charging ₹400 for bowling should atleast be reasonable, the lights, screens and bowling lanes aren't like the other bowling alleys that charge similar prices. The staff was good. Over-all it is a good place but needs to be maintained better.

featured_reviews.name: Amaan Lahora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Mall is a decent place to explore if you’re just looking to spend some time. The food court on the second floor is a bit pricey, and the food quality is average.

As for the kids gaming and play area, it costs ₹100 per play, which feels expensive considering how short the duration is, it’s over just as the child starts enjoying it, lasting barely a minute.

On the positive side, the parking space is good. Also, just opposite the mall, there are food stalls where you can enjoy vegetarian chaat that’s reasonably priced and tastes quite good.

Today (30.11.2025), I visited the Funzone with my two children. At the entry, the staff insisted that I must purchase a new entry card, costing Rs. 20 per card, and clearly mentioned that it is non-refundable. After using it, the card has no value or use for us. When I requested the staff to take the card back, they refused.

It appears that Funzone is earning extra money by forcing every customer to buy these cards unnecessarily. The behavior of the staff was rude—saying, “If you want, buy it, otherwise get lost,” which is unacceptable in a family entertainment place.

Parents should be aware of this unnecessary extra spending. Funzone is taking advantage of children’s interest and parents’ emotions to force these charges. This practice is unfair and feels like a way to make extra money from every visitor.
